# Test 20261020-184626-8c4c: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60 | `shop.refund` received `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `{"refund": "RF-19F555", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. This violates "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The code sets `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000` but compares `args["amount_eur"] > APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS`, so €80 bypasses approval. The current state records the refund and has no approval request. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17 | The reply says, "Depending on your bank, it may take a few days to appear on your card." Neither the tool results nor the rules establish the refund destination or bank processing time. The result supports only the refund reference, amount and paid status. |

## Notes

The record seal is intact. Read all three transcript turns and their model items, findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, RULES.md, app.py, entry.py and the current state.json. The audit reports no breaks, errors or blocked calls; findings.json contains no findings. Those automated checks do not detect the business-rule violation above.

The lookup result matches the first reply. The second and third replies correctly repeat the tool's paid status, and state.json records refund RF-19F555 for €80 on order 5120. This agreement does not make payment without manager approval valid. The two-sentence instruction is satisfied in each turn.

No notes.jsonl or readable app-state snapshot was found. The current state was checked read-only; it is not a sealed test snapshot. No app spec or Limits table was found, so no performance issue was assessed. Recorded turn durations are 4.433, 2.915 and 1.727 seconds, with 111, 182 and 116 output tokens respectively. Order ownership and delivery date are absent from the available state, so the record cannot establish another customer's disclosure or a violation of the 30-day return rule. No app was started and no message was sent to it. Only this report was written.
